title: EEP Session Token
description: Signed session token issued by a publisher after successful gate requirement satisfaction. Presented via Authorization: EEP-Session <token> header on subsequent requests. (§6, Whitepaper).

agent_did.description: DID of the agent this session token is bound to. Must match the presenting agent's DID key.

issuer_did.description: DID of the publisher that issued this session token. Used for signature verification.

tiers.description: Gate tiers the agent has been granted access to.

exp.description: Expiry time as UNIX timestamp (seconds). Must be greater than iat.

refresh_threshold.description: UNIX timestamp before which the agent should proactively request renewal. Typically exp minus 10% of the session duration.

context_id.description: Opaque identifier the agent can use to resume interrupted operations, such as replaying missed events from a specific SSE position.

gate_version.description: Version of the gate configuration at the time this token was issued. Allows the publisher to detect config changes on renewal.

signature.description: EdDSA signature (base64url) over a canonical JSON serialization of all fields except 'signature', keyed to issuer_did's verification key.
